easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Phyrexian Metamorph.
description:
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Phyrexian Metamorph. Choose to have Phyrexian Metamorph enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.
